title: No router-stack test for /reference POST/PUT — missing csrf.should_skip arm 403s any referee holding an rt_session cookie
detail: Every /reference test calls form_handler.* directly, bypassing router.handle_request. csrf.should_skip lacks a reference arm, so a referee holding any rt_session cookie gets 403 CSRF_INVALID on answer POST/PUT/resend — the no-JS first-class path breaks.
recommended_fix: Add ["reference", _] -> True to csrf.should_skip and add through-router pins (no-cookie and signed-cookie POST/PUT) mirroring erasure_post_with_session_cookie_through_router_still_succeeds_test.

title: Resend delivered branch unpinned: remint success (new token, 10-day TTL, audit row) is never asserted
detail: Only reference_call_link_resent assertion expects 0 rows (rollback). A broken remint (token unchanged, wrong TTL, audit write missing) passes CI; the NOTE's claimed 'guarded SQL's integration coverage elsewhere in this file' is absent — no test references remint_form_token.
recommended_fix: Add a direct SQL integration pin: seed an expired open row, call sql.remint_form_token, assert new token persisted with expiry ≈ now()+10 days, then restore_form_token round-trips the old state.

title: handle_unknown_path catch-all arm (GET /reference/..) has zero test coverage
detail: The catch-all keeping typo'd deep links off the SPA shell (AC7: analytics against a token-carrying URL) is unpinned; a regression routing these GETs to serve_spa_shell would pass CI.
recommended_fix: Add a test asserting GET /reference/<token>/<unknown> returns the branded 404 (status 404, data-testid reference-not-found) via the router arm.

title: Advisory test gate: FAIL
detail: P0 <100%: the critical-path answer/autosave/resend stack has no through-router coverage, and the missing csrf.should_skip arm demonstrably 403s session-cookie referees; resend delivered branch and catch-all unpinned. Overall ≈75%.
recommended_fix: Add the csrf.should_skip reference arm, through-router POST/PUT/resend pins (no-cookie + signed-cookie), a direct remint/restore SQL round-trip pin, and a catch-all arm test; then re-run the gate.
